title: Flap change dynamics (Retraction)
objective: Demonstrate simulator response to flap retraction in the second-to-third-segment climb condition.
demonstration: Retract takeoff flaps to the initial flap-retracted position and allow free response. Record at least 5 seconds before motion and 15 seconds after motion ends.
tolerance_catalog: +/- 1.5 deg or +/- 20% pitch angle | +/- 3 kt airspeed | +/- 30 m (100 ft) altitude
runtime_configuration: Existing Flap Change Dynamics Manual and Recorded Replay workflow
